brief_summary: This is a study designed to evaluate the potential for the pradigastat (LCQ908) to impact cardiovascular risk.
brief_title: Efficacy of LCQ908 on Cardiovascular Risk

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of coronary artery disease
* Elevated triglycerides
* On medication to help lower cholesterol

Exclusion Criteria:

* Poorly controlled diabetic patients and/or change in diabetic medication within 12 weeks of screening
* History of myocardial infarction (heart attack) within 6 months of screening
* History of a procedure to open a blocked coronary artery within 12 months of enrollment
* History of Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) surgery
* History of congestive heart failure
* History of significant heart valve disease

official_title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo Controlled Study to Assess the Efficacy of LCQ908 on Cardiovascular Risk

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Myocardial Perfusion Reserve Index (MPRi) Overall Mean (Part A, Cohort 1)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Baseline, and on day 5 of each of the two treatment periods

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Total Exercise Duration (Part A, Cohort 1)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Baseline and on day 5 of each of the two treatment periods

primary_outcomes.measure: Time to Onset of Angina (Part A, Cohort 1)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Baseline and on day 5 of each of the two treatment periods

primary_outcomes.measure: Time to Onset of Exercise-induced Ischemia(Part A, Cohort 1)
